LESSON: THE RICH MAN AND LAZARUS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.7: The Rich man and Lazarus
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers The Rich man and Lazarus, part of The Life of Jesus Christ in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How should Christians use their wealth?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe the parable of the rich man and Lazarus,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Rich man and Lazarus in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. discuss lessons learnt from the parable of the rich man and Lazarus,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Rich man and Lazarus in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. live responsibly as God- fearing Christians.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of The Rich man and Lazarus in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: the skill of developing relations is exhibited as learners, in groups, share what they have learnt from the

parable of the rich man and Lazarus.

• Digital literacy: the skill of connecting using technology is enhanced as learners connect to and use the internet to search

for the necessary information.

Values:
• Love: learners share and use their resources to support one another.

• Respect: learners value human dignity as they help those in need.

Link to other Learning Areas:

• Science and Technology skills are applied as learners use digital devices to search for information from the internet.

• Creative Arts: creative skills are applied as learners role-play the parable of the rich man and Lazarus.
